messages:
Jaden Park: Quick sync on Redcliff private deployment. They want cutover Friday EOD but security flagged a couple items: KMS HSM proof, cross-account role ARN, and audit-stream lag. Can we confirm owners and minimal acceptance criteria?
Leah Ortiz: I'll own audit log flow + Splunk validation. Need the endpoint, HEC token scope, and expected event schema sample. If we can prove <5s median latency for HEC forwarding in our smoke run, theyll be happy.
Omar Khan: I'll take the IAM/Cross-account piece. They requested an assume-role that only allows S3:GetObject for model pulls and CloudWatch PutMetricData for metrics. Also must restrict to source IPs: 10.200.0.0/16 (peered subnet).
Marta Silva: Security here. KMS: contract requires an HSM-backed CMK in the customer's account and the key policy must explicitly allow Redwood principal with kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey. We also need an entry proving Key Origin = AWS_KMS (no external key store). They said rotation is customer-managed yearly.
Jaden Park: Noted. Leah - do you have a quick test plan we can run with their Splunk team?
Leah Ortiz: Minimal test plan: 1) We send 500 events over 60s containing request_id, model_id, user_id; 2) Their HEC returns 200 for >99% of events; 3) Search query returns those request_ids within 15s. I'll post exact curl example.
Omar Khan: For the role trust policy I'm proposing this (will fill REDWOOD_ACCOUNT soon):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REPLACE_REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-runtime"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"IpAddress": {"aws:SourceIp": "10.200.0.0/16"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Also attach inline policy limiting S3/CloudWatch actions.
Marta Silva: Add kms:Decrypt to that role. Also confirm the CMK key policy has a Condition preventing redwood from scheduling automatic rotation.
Jaden Park: Good catch. Ops question: outbound egress — do we need to ask for any additional public CIDRs? Redcliff runs in a NATed subnet and will only talk to our registry + telemetry.
Leah Ortiz: Egress list (to be whitelisted):
- 34.82.150.0/24 (registry-us)
- 52.23.46.0/24 (telemetry-us)
- TCP 443 to api.redwood-inference.com
I'll include a one-line firewall snippet.
Marta Silva: For audit evidence: they requested an SHA256 fingerprint of the CMK and an attest doc from their KMS admin before cutover. We need that 48h before Friday or they push back the cutover.
Omar Khan: I'll prepare the assume-role template and inline policy by EOD. Leah can you post the curl HEC example in this thread?
Leah Ortiz: On it. Example payload:
```bash
curl -k https://splunk.example.com:8088/services/collector/event \
  -H "Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"event": {"request_id": "test-123", "model_id": "gpt-medium-v1", "user_id": "u-42"}}'
```
Expect 200 response.
Jaden Park: Action recap: Omar = IAM/trust policy + role ARN; Marta = KMS key policy checklist + get CMK fingerprint requirement into contract notes; Leah = Splunk HEC smoke run plan + firewall snippet; Jaden = schedule joint cutover call and send invites. If any item misses its deadline (Omar/Leah by tomorrow COB, Marta by Wednesday EOD), we flag renewal risk and delay.
security-bot: reminder: create compliance ticket CC:security-team. Ticket id: SEC-9921.
Marta Silva: I'll also ask their security lead for the HSM compliance cert (FIPS 140-2 level) copy. If they don't provide by Wed we'll escalate.
Omar Khan: FYI I tested assume-role locally with a stubbed REDWOOD_ACCOUNT and the policy evaluation looks fine. Will update when I have the real account.
Leah Ortiz: I'll run the HEC smoke against their staging endpoint tomorrow and publish results here.
Jaden Park: Thanks team. I'll draft the customer-facing checklist and send to Redcliff PM. Meeting invite after we get the CMK fingerprint and a successful HEC smoke. :calendar:
